question: Unsere AG ist keine Holding. Bei der letzten Kapitalerhöhung haben wir die neuen Aktien teurer als zum Nennwert verkauft, und dieses Geld möchten wir jetzt an die Aktionäre zurückzahlen. Vor zwei Jahren haben wir zudem eine Liegenschaft höher bewertet, um einen Verlust auszugleichen. Ab welcher Höhe der Reserven ist die Rückzahlung erlaubt, zählt der Betrag aus der Höherbewertung dabei mit, und wie kann dieser Betrag später wieder aufgelöst werden?

gold_facts.text: The proceeds from issuing shares above their nominal value, less the issue costs, are allocated to the statutory capital reserve.
The statutory capital reserve may be repaid to shareholders if the statutory capital and profit reserves, less any losses, exceed half of the share capital entered in the commercial register.
The statutory profit reserve from revaluations is not taken into account when calculating that threshold.
The revaluation reserve can be dissolved only by conversion into share or participation capital, or by a value adjustment or sale of the revalued assets.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring provision on the statutory profit reserve sets a similar half-of-capital threshold for repayment of profit reserves.
note: Revised per critic: fact 1 now says issue costs are deducted, not allocated.

question: La ditta per cui lavoro si affida a un agente indipendente, che non è suo dipendente, e che le procura clienti in modo stabile. Se nel contratto non si dice nulla, questa persona può incassare i soldi dai clienti o concedere loro più tempo per pagare? E può almeno ricevere i reclami dei clienti per merce difettosa?

gold_facts.text: The agent is presumed to be authorised to receive customers' notices of defects and other declarations by which they assert or reserve rights for defective performance by the principal.
The agent is presumed not to be authorised to receive payments, grant extensions of payment or agree other changes to the contract with customers.

competing_candidates: The employment-law rule on the powers of a salaried commercial traveller (excluded: the question states the person is not an employee).
note: Revised per critic: states the representative is independent, not an employee. Fact 1 trimmed to the part the question asks.

question: Avec deux amis, nous avons fondé une société en commandite dans laquelle je ne réponds des dettes que jusqu'à un montant fixé. Avant même que la société soit inscrite au registre du commerce, elle a passé des commandes chez un fournisseur. Envers ce fournisseur, ma responsabilité reste-t-elle limitée à ce montant ?

gold_facts.text: If the limited partnership did business before being entered in the commercial register, the limited partner is liable to third parties like a partner with unlimited liability for the partnership's obligations that arose before registration.
This unlimited liability does not apply if the limited partner proves that the third parties knew his liability was limited.

competing_candidates: The general limited-partnership rule that the limited partner is liable only up to the registered limited sum (it states the normal limit, not the pre-registration exception).
note: Revised per critic: asks only about the extent of liability, not about being sued alone.

question: Ho autorizzato mio fratello a comprare per me un'auto usata da un privato. Lui l'ha acquistata, ma al venditore non ha mai detto che lo faceva per conto mio. Adesso chi è vincolato al venditore dal contratto, io o mio fratello?

gold_facts.text: Rights and obligations from a contract concluded by an authorised representative in another person's name pass to the person represented.

If the representative did not disclose that he was acting as a representative, the represented person becomes directly creditor or debtor only if the other party had to infer the agency from the circumstances or did not care with whom it contracted.

competing_candidates: The mandate rule on claims acquired by a mandatary in his own name passing to the principal (the delivery sub-question was removed so it no longer bears on the question).
note: Revised per critic: delivery sub-question and assignment fact removed.

question: Ich bin Aktionär einer börsenkotierten AG, deren Jahresrechnung voll und nicht bloss eingeschränkt geprüft werden muss. Schaut der Prüfer nach, ob die Firma überhaupt Vorkehrungen zur Überwachung ihrer eigenen Abläufe hat und ob der Bericht über die Bezüge der Spitzenleute stimmt? Und beurteilt er auch, ob die Unternehmensspitze die Firma gut geführt hat?

gold_facts.text: The auditor checks whether an internal control system exists and, for companies whose shares are listed on a stock exchange, whether the compensation report complies with the law and the articles.
The board of directors' management of the company is not subject to the auditor's review.

competing_candidates: The stock-company article on the scope of a limited audit, which also excludes the board's management from review (the question states a full, not a limited audit, and asks about the internal control system and compensation report, which only A covers).
note: Revised per critic: paraphrased to avoid copying the article's terms. Dropped the fact on annual accounts and profit proposal, which the question does not ask.

question: Je vais prendre une voiture en leasing auprès d'un garage, pour mon usage privé. Le contrat doit-il être écrit, et quelles informations doit-il obligatoirement contenir, notamment sur ce que je devrai payer si j'arrête le leasing avant la fin ?

gold_facts.text: Consumer leasing contracts must be concluded in writing, and the lessee receives a copy.

The contract must state, among other things, a description of the leased item and its cash price, the number, amount and due dates of the instalments, any deposit, and the effective annual interest rate.
The contract must include a table showing what the lessee must pay, in addition to instalments already paid, if the lease ends early, and the residual value of the item at that time.

competing_candidates: The rule on the lessee's right to terminate a leasing contract early, and the general contract-content rule for cash credits, are nearby in the same act; the question asks about form and contents of a leasing contract.
note: Revised per critic: private use stated so the consumer credit act applies.

question: Une plateforme en ligne organise pour moi un prêt pour acheter une moto, financé ensemble par plusieurs particuliers qui prêtent leur argent à titre privé. Quel statut la loi sur le crédit à la consommation donne-t-elle à cette plateforme, et en quoi se distingue-t-elle d'une entreprise qui se contente de me trouver un crédit auprès d'un prêteur ?

gold_facts.text: A credit intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally brokers consumer credit contracts.

A crowdlending intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally organises, for individual consumers, a coordinated granting of consumer credit in which several lenders not acting professionally can take part.

competing_candidates: The definitions of the lender and of the consumer credit contract are neighbouring definitions in the same act.
note: Revised per critic: removed the article's title term and the close paraphrase of the non-professional lender wording.

question: I am taking out a cash loan from a consumer lender. Which figure about the yearly cost of the loan has to be written in my contract, and is there a legal ceiling on that rate? Who fixes it, and what upper limit does the law itself set as a rule?

gold_facts.text: The contract must state the effective annual interest rate or, if that is not possible, the annual interest rate and the costs charged at conclusion.
The Federal Council sets the maximum permitted interest rate for that effective annual rate, taking into account the refinancing rates determined by the National Bank.
The maximum interest rate should as a rule not exceed 15 percent.

competing_candidates: The articles on contract contents for credit card / overdraft credit and leasing also require stating an interest rate.
note: Revised per critic: asks for the statutory limit, not the ordinance figure. Dropped the written-form fact, which the question does not ask.

question: After a burglary I told my insurer the door had been locked, although I had actually left it open, because I feared they would pay less. If they find out I said this on purpose to mislead them, what happens to my cover?

gold_facts.text: If the claimant or their representative, in order to deceive, misstated or concealed facts that would exclude or reduce the insurer's liability, the insurer is not bound by the contract towards the claimant.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations rules on fraud in contract conclusion and the insurance act rules on breach of pre-contractual disclosure are topically close but concern other moments.
note: Revised per critic: removed the fact on late or missing notifications.

question: Ho scoperto solo adesso che la mia compagnia, prima che firmassi, non mi aveva spiegato, come avrebbe dovuto, gli elementi essenziali della polizza. Posso uscire dal contratto per questo motivo? Come devo fare e fino a quando posso farlo?

gold_facts.text: If the insurer breached its duty to inform, the policyholder may terminate the insurance contract in writing or in another form that allows proof by text, effective on receipt by the insurer.
The termination right lapses four weeks after the policyholder learns of the breach and of the required information.
The termination right lapses at the latest two years after the breach.

competing_candidates: The article setting out the insurer's information duty itself is topically close but does not give the remedy.
note: Revised per critic: Italian grammar fixed.

question: Une administration fédérale a été victime d'un piratage informatique et des dossiers de citoyens ont fuité. Une enquête pénale est en cours et la police craint que prévenir les personnes touchées maintenant ne la fasse échouer. L'administration doit-elle quand même avertir ces personnes, ou peut-elle attendre ou y renoncer?

gold_facts.text: The controller must inform the data subject of a data security breach when this is necessary for the data subject's protection or when the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner requires it.
The controller may restrict, defer or waive informing the data subject where one of the specific grounds on which a federal body may restrict a data subject's right of access applies.
For a federal body, one such ground is that communicating the information is likely to compromise an investigation, an inquiry or judicial or administrative proceedings.

note: Revised per critic: fact 2 narrowed to the federal-body access-restriction grounds the article refers to (no longer any access-restriction ground). Dropped the public-security ground, which the question does not ask.

question: Un venditore di una ditta concorrente, durante le sue visite ai clienti, racconta che i miei prodotti sono pericolosi, cosa falsa. Per farlo smettere e far chiarire le cose davanti ai clienti, posso agire in giudizio direttamente contro la ditta per cui lavora, oppure solo contro di lui?

gold_facts.text: Where the act of unfair competition was committed by an employee or other auxiliary in the course of their work, the injured party's actions to prohibit, remove or have declared unlawful the unfair act, and to have a correction or the judgment communicated to third parties, can also be brought against the employer.

competing_candidates: The Code of Obligations article on the employer's liability for damage caused by employees (it concerns damages, while the question asks to stop and correct the conduct).
note: Revised per critic: fact now covers both groups of actions the article refers to, including correction towards third parties. The list of actions comes from the referenced article of the same act; A extends those actions to the employer.

question: Ich bin auf eine Abofalle einer Firma aus dem Ausland hereingefallen, und offenbar betrifft das viele Leute in mehreren Ländern. Dürfen die Bundesbehörden, die in der Schweiz gegen solche Geschäftsmethoden vorgehen, mit den Behörden der anderen Länder zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam ermitteln, und unter welchen Voraussetzungen?

gold_facts.text: The federal authorities responsible for enforcing the Unfair Competition Act may cooperate with competent foreign authorities and international organisations or bodies, and in particular coordinate investigations.
This cooperation requires that it is necessary to combat unfair business practices and that the foreign authorities or bodies are bound by official secrecy or an equivalent duty of confidentiality.

note: Revised per critic: removed the fact on Federal Council treaties.

question: Pendant mon litige avec un voisin au sujet d'une parcelle de terrain, j'ai vendu ce terrain. L'acheteur peut-il prendre ma place dans la procédure, et qui doit payer les frais, y compris ceux déjà engagés avant la vente ?

gold_facts.text: If the object in dispute is transferred during the proceedings, the acquirer may take over the proceedings in place of the transferring party.
The party taking over is liable for all court costs, but the withdrawing party remains jointly and severally liable for the court costs incurred up to that point.

note: Revised per critic: paraphrased the article phrase and removed the security fact.

question: Ich wohne in Zürich und klage vor einem Schweizer Gericht gegen eine Firma auf Zahlung von 20'000 Franken aus einem Kaufvertrag. Aus einem früheren Gerichtsverfahren habe ich die Kosten bis heute nicht bezahlt. Die Firma verlangt jetzt, dass ich vorab eine Sicherheit für ihre Anwaltskosten hinterlege. Muss ich das bei einem so kleinen Betrag überhaupt?

gold_facts.text: On the defendant's request, the plaintiff must provide security for party costs if it still owes court costs from earlier proceedings.
There is no duty to provide security in the simplified procedure, except in pecuniary disputes that fall under that procedure because of their value in dispute.
The simplified procedure applies to pecuniary disputes with a value in dispute of up to CHF 30,000.

competing_candidates: The civil procedure article on the advance on court costs, which concerns court fees rather than security for the other party's costs.
note: Revised per critic: plaintiff now lives in Switzerland (no treaty issue); the ground is unpaid costs from earlier proceedings. Answer: yes, security is owed; the 20,000 claim is in the simplified procedure only by value, which is the exception to the exemption.

question: Ho chiesto un piccolo prestito in contanti a una banca. Quale tasso d'interesse massimo ha fissato attualmente il Consiglio federale per i crediti in contanti, e quale per lo scoperto della carta di credito?
trap_reason: The Consumer Credit Act only empowers the Federal Council to fix the maximum rate; the rates currently in force for cash loans and card overdrafts are set in the implementing ordinance, not in the act.
note: Likely wrong retrieval: the Consumer Credit Act article on the maximum interest rate, which states only that the Federal Council fixes it and a general guideline ceiling.

question: We are separating and our son is 10. Which calculation method has the Federal Supreme Court prescribed for child support, and which tables do courts use to put a figure on a 10-year-old's monthly needs?
trap_reason: The Civil Code only names the criteria for child support; the calculation method comes from Federal Supreme Court case law and the needs tables from cantonal or practice sources.
note: Likely wrong retrieval: Civil Code article on the criteria for child maintenance (needs of the child, situation and means of the parents).

question: Mein Vater wurde früher mit 19 Jahren, also noch vor dem damaligen Mündigkeitsalter, auf Antrag für mündig erklärt. Welche Voraussetzungen stellte das ZGB an eine solche vorzeitige Mündigerklärung, und welche Behörde entschied darüber?
trap_reason: The Civil Code provision on early declaration of majority was repealed with effect from 1 January 1996, so no in-force article states its conditions or the deciding authority.
note: Likely wrong retrieval: Civil Code articles on the age of majority and on the capacity of minors.

question: I want to sign a contract online so that it has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature. Which providers are currently recognised in Switzerland to issue the certificates for such a signature, and what does one cost?
trap_reason: The Code of Obligations only refers to recognised certification providers in general; which providers are currently recognised and their prices are set outside the 8 acts (the electronic signatures legislation and market practice).
note: Likely wrong retrieval: Code of Obligations article on signatures, which equates a qualified electronic signature with a handwritten one.
